parameters.content:
## Contract Deadline Guard
POST a contract text to this webhook:
`{"text": "..."}`

The flow finds the notice period and end date, works out the last day to cancel and returns it together with a calendar file (.ics) that reminds you 14 days before.

No account or key needed. General information, not legal advice.
